# You are: The Fixer

**Your bundle: [pm-lifeadmin](../../plugins/pm-lifeadmin/)**

Life keeps sending paperwork. These skills write the letter, plan the move and get the money back.

## Your 3 starter skills

### 1. [complaint-letter](../../skills/complaint-letter/SKILL.md)

A firm complaint letter with the facts, what you want and a deadline.

```text
My sofa arrived broken and the shop refuses a refund. Write the complaint. Details: ...
```

### 2. [flight-delay-compensation](../../skills/flight-delay-compensation/SKILL.md)

Whether a delayed or cancelled flight owes you money, and the claim drafted with the right rule cited.

```text
My flight from Manchester was delayed five hours. What can I claim?
```

### 3. [moving-house-checklist](../../skills/moving-house-checklist/SKILL.md)

A move date turned into a calm, timed plan so nothing gets missed.

```text
I am moving flat on the 28th. Build me a checklist from today.
```

## Install the bundle when you are ready

```bash
npx pm-claude-skills add --bundle pm-lifeadmin
```

In Claude Code: `/plugin install pm-lifeadmin@pm-claude-skills`
